onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.welcome_subtitle: Bring Gmail, Outlook and iCloud into one place. AI sorts, tags and cleans up for you.
onboarding.feature_local_title: Your data stays on this device
onboarding.feature_local_body: Mail is analyzed right on your device. No server ever stores the message content.
onboarding.feature_cloud_title: Cloud AI only with your permission
onboarding.feature_cloud_body: Off by default. Turning it on always asks first and keeps a transparent log.
onboarding.feature_undo_body: Cleaned mail goes to Trash. Finance and HR mail is always protected.
onboarding.try_demo_cta: Try it with a sample mailbox
onboarding.terms_notice: By continuing you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.
onboarding.add_account_subtitle: Connects over IMAP. Your password is stored in this device's Keychain.
onboarding.outlook_intro: Personal Outlook/Microsoft 365 accounts sign in through Microsoft (OAuth2).
onboarding.outlook_oauth_disabled: Outlook sign-in isn't available in this build yet (missing client ID). Use Gmail, iCloud or another IMAP account for now.
onboarding.icloud_guide_step1: Open account.apple.com and sign in to your Apple ID.
onboarding.icloud_guide_step2: Go to Sign-In and Security › App-Specific Passwords.
onboarding.icloud_guide_step3: Tap +, name it "AI Smart Mail", then copy the 16-character code.
onboarding.icloud_guide_step4: Paste it below. Your real Apple ID password is never used.
onboarding.gmail_guide_step2: Go to App Passwords, create one for "AI Smart Mail", then paste it below.
onboarding.google_oauth_waiting: Waiting for you to confirm in the browser…
onboarding.google_oauth_disabled: Missing GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID for this build — see docs/OAUTH_GOOGLE.md
onboarding.gmail_alt_app_password: Another way: use an app password
onboarding.error_gmail_app_password: Gmail doesn't accept your normal Google password here. Turn on 2-Step Verification, create an App Password (16 characters) at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords and paste it into the Password field.
onboarding.error_gmail_invalid: Wrong email or app password. Re-check the 16-character code (no spaces) and make sure IMAP is enabled in Gmail › Settings › Forwarding and POP/IMAP.
onboarding.error_icloud_app_password: iCloud needs an app-specific password, not your Apple ID password. Create one at account.apple.com › Sign-In and Security › App-Specific Passwords.
onboarding.error_outlook_oauth_required: Outlook.com/Microsoft 365 no longer allows password sign-in over IMAP. Microsoft sign-in (OAuth) is required — configure OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID.
onboarding.error_network: Couldn't reach the mail server. Check your connection, host and port (IMAP is usually 993).
